people.name: Asa
people.line: King of Judah, son of Abijah; father of Jehoshaphat

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: But the high places were not taken away out of Israel; nevertheless the heart of Asa was perfect all his days.
translations.bsb: The high places were not removed from Israel, but Asa’s heart was fully devoted all his days.
